_doc: The targets of the performance bench of the macOS guest. One source for packaging/macos/bench.sh (through paddock macvm bench) and for the Linux test bench::baseline_meets_targets. Every number is an upper bound; samples is the least number of samples a measure needs. frames is the gap between two distinct frames in ms: 17 ms is 60 fps, and no frame older than 50 ms. idle.ram is the configured memory of the VM, 4 GiB: the memory balloon hung the guest in an early test on a Mac, so the guest keeps its memory. disk is the profile without the app copy.
